+from validate_movie_export import independent

+ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+CUDA=ROOT/'solver/cuda'
+OUT=CUDA/'validation/janhunen_movie'
+PARENT=CUDA/'mhd_cuda_fp32_async_hlld_janhunen'
+MOVIE=CUDA/'mhd_cuda_fp32_async_hlld_janhunen_movie'
+NAMES=['probe.csv','step_histogram.csv','hlld_fallbacks.json','local_repair.json',
+       'local_repair_histogram.csv','boundary_thermo_metadata.json',
+       'divergence_source.json','metadata.json','r_au.npy','theta_rad.npy','phi_rad.npy']

+          'mean_dimensionless_divB','max_dimensionless_divB','weighted_dimensionless_divB',
+          'device_allocated_MB']
+
+def sha(path):return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
+def read(path):return dict(line.split('=',1) for line in path.read_text().splitlines() if '=' in line)
+def manifest(folder):return list(csv.DictReader((folder/'snapshots.csv').open()))
+
+def run(values,name,binary):
+    folder=OUT/name
+    if (folder/'statistics.json').exists():raise RuntimeError('Refusing to overwrite completed gate: '+str(folder))
+    config=OUT/(name+'.cfg')
+    config.write_text(''.join(f'{key}={value}\n' for key,value in {**values,'output_dir':folder}.items()))
+    with (OUT/(name+'.log')).open('w') as log:
+        subprocess.run(['nice','-n','15',str(binary),'--config',str(config)],stdout=log,stderr=log,check=True,timeout=90)
+    return folder
+
+def compare(parent,other,full=False):
+    names=list(NAMES)
+    if full:names+=['snapshots.csv']+[p.name for p in sorted(parent.glob('snapshot_*.npy'))]
+    same={name:(parent/name).read_bytes()==(other/name).read_bytes() for name in names}
+    a=json.loads((parent/'statistics.json').read_text());b=json.loads((other/'statistics.json').read_text())
+    same.update({key:a[key]==b[key] for key in PHYSICAL})
+    assert all(same.values()),same
+    return {'all_required_outputs_identical':True,'identity_checks':same,
+            'parent_statistics':a,'movie_statistics':b,
+            'parent_output_sha256':{name:sha(parent/name) for name in names},
+            'movie_output_sha256':{name:sha(other/name) for name in names}}
+
+def main():
+    OUT.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
+    source=CUDA/'validation/cached_local/enabled_parent.cfg'
+    values=read(source)
+    values.update(divergence_source='janhunen',local_repair_max_iterations=1)
+    assert values['start_day']=='9' and values['end_day']=='10.1'
+    frozen=json.loads((CUDA/'mhd_cuda_fp32_async_hlld_janhunen_movie_provenance.json').read_text())
+    for path,value in frozen['parent_sources'].items():assert sha(ROOT/path)==value,path
+    assert sha(MOVIE)==frozen['binary_sha256']
+    parent=run(values,'parent',PARENT)
+    disabled=run(values,'disabled',MOVIE)
+    default_identity=compare(parent,disabled,full=True)
+    trace_values={**values,'snapshots_do_not_trim_timestep':1,'output_start_day':9,'snapshot_days':.25}
+    trace=run(trace_values,'nontrim_full_trace',MOVIE)
+    trace_identity=compare(parent,trace)
+    assert sorted(parent.glob('snapshot_*.npy'))[-1].read_bytes()==sorted(trace.glob('snapshot_*.npy'))[-1].read_bytes()
+    matrix_file=ROOT/'observations/coordinate_system.json'
+    matrix=json.loads(matrix_file.read_text())['ecliptic_to_solar_equatorial_matrix']
+    enabled_values={**trace_values,'ecliptic_slice_pixels':65,'ecliptic_slice_extent_au':2.3,
+        'ecliptic_slice_matrix':','.join(format(v,'.17g') for row in matrix for v in row),
+        'ecliptic_slice_matrix_source':matrix_file,'diagnostic_volume_days':'9.25,9.75'}
+    enabled=run(enabled_values,'enabled_nontrimming',MOVIE)
+    output_identity=compare(parent,enabled)
+    rows=manifest(enabled);trace_rows=manifest(trace)
+    assert [r['day'] for r in rows]==[r['day'] for r in trace_rows]
+    assert abs(float(rows[-1]['day'])-float(values['end_day']))<1e-10
+    slices={row['file']:independent(enabled,trace/row['file'],enabled_values) for row in trace_rows}
+    assert all(np.load(enabled/row['file']).ndim==2 for row in rows)
+    assert not list(enabled.glob('snapshot_*.npy'))
+    diagnostic=enabled/'diagnostic_volumes';diag_rows=manifest(diagnostic)
+    request_map=list(csv.DictReader((diagnostic/'requested_vs_actual.csv').open()))
+    assert len(diag_rows)==len(request_map)==2
+    volume_checks={}
+    probe_days=np.genfromtxt(enabled/'probe.csv',delimiter=',',names=True)['day']
+    assert len(probe_days)>200,'Meaningful 5min probes required'
+    for row,mapping in zip(diag_rows,request_map):
+        match=[other for other in trace_rows if abs(float(other['day'])-float(row['day']))<1e-10]
+        actual=float(mapping['actual_day'])
+        assert len(match)==1 and abs(actual-float(row['day']))<1e-10
+        assert probe_days.min()<=actual<=probe_days.max(),'Diagnostic geometry would extrapolate'
+        volume_checks[row['file']]=(diagnostic/row['file']).read_bytes()==(trace/match[0]['file']).read_bytes()
+        assert volume_checks[row['file']]
+    assert all((diagnostic/name).read_bytes()==(enabled/name).read_bytes() for name in ['r_au.npy','theta_rad.npy','phi_rad.npy'])
+    pointer=json.loads((diagnostic/'parent.json').read_text())
+    assert pointer['parent_probe_file']=='../probe.csv' and pointer['comet_probe_id']==0
+    assert (diagnostic/'run.cfg').is_file()
+    assert json.loads((diagnostic/'metadata.json').read_text())['shape']==[24,4,24,8]
+    source_mode=json.loads((enabled/'divergence_source.json').read_text());assert source_mode['mode']=='janhunen'
+    repair=json.loads((enabled/'local_repair.json').read_text())
+    assert repair['accepted_local_repair_steps']>0,'Fixture did not exercise repaired states'
+    for path,value in frozen['parent_sources'].items():assert sha(ROOT/path)==value,path
+    report={'created_utc':dt.datetime.now(dt.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
+        'scope':'Output-only identity for this frozen induction-only Janhunen model; no precision/convergence claim.',
+        'parent_source':frozen['parent_sources'],'parent_binary_sha256':sha(PARENT),
+        'movie_binary_sha256':sha(MOVIE),'movie_source_sha256':frozen['generated_source_sha256'],

+        'enabled_nontrimming_identity':output_identity,'locally_repaired_steps':repair['accepted_local_repair_steps'],
+        'probe_rows':len(probe_days),'actual_snapshot_manifest':rows,
+        'independent_all_slice_comparisons':slices,
+        'sparse_diagnostics':{'manifest':diag_rows,'requested_actual_mapping':request_map,
+            'volumes_byte_identical_to_full_parent_trace':volume_checks,'axes_byte_identical':True,
+            'parent_pointer':pointer,'geometry_extrapolation':False,
+            'main_manifest_retains_only_2D_arrays':True,
+            'host_output_path_stream_index_restoration_verified_by_subsequent_main_snapshots':True}}
+    (OUT/'verification.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
+    print(json.dumps({'default_disabled_identity':True,'untrimmed_physical_identity':True,
+        'source_mode':'janhunen','locally_repaired_steps':repair['accepted_local_repair_steps'],
+        'probe_rows':len(probe_days),'slices_written':len(rows),
+        'maximum_slice_relative_difference':max(v['maximum_relative_flux_difference'] for v in slices.values()),
+        'sparse_3D_volumes_identical':volume_checks,'verification':str(OUT/'verification.json')},indent=2))
+
+if __name__=='__main__':main()
